mentions.name: 3D-printed iPhone mount stand
mentions.description: A 3D-printed stand, made using nurb, for mounting an iPhone to record activity on the reMarkable 2; developed by testing small physical prototypes of parts before rolling them into the full stand.
mentions.source_excerpt: Using nurb, to 3d print things, currently working thru printing a stand, so I can mount an iphone and record doing things on the remarkable. Its been really fun testing with little physical prototypes of small parts to then roll into the stand.
mentions.author: freshteapot
